crossRefs.note: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take…
Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.
The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken…
He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed…

people.name: Adam
people.line: The first man, created by God

translations.web: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.
translations.bsb: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
translations.kjv: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
translations.asv: male and female created he them, and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
